body:
## Summary

This updates all examples to use function templates, with `html` when necessary.

We're still using string HTML and deprecated APIs when using connectors (e.g., in `example-instantsearch-media`), which we can do another pass on later on as we might be able to use templates and simplify the examples instead of pulling Preact directly.
